statement:
The record requests administrator access, but because this account belongs to an outside partner, company policy requires read-only access.
Access request AR-3391 resolved. The account `svc-integrations@partner-ext.io` was assigned **read-only** access.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the requested "administrator of the whole company" level violates policy for an outside partner and substitutes the correct value: "was assigned **read-only** access."
